subject: fix: a decision or resume claims the run before stepping it, so two requests on one run take turns
task:
fix: a decision or resume claims the run before stepping it, so two requests on one run take turns

Two decisions on the same waiting run could both pass the state check and
both step the same checkpoint; nothing in the service stopped them, only the
agents' own idempotency. The runner now marks the row running with a
compare-and-set on the state and the updated stamp it read (both, because
updated is kept to the second and two claims inside one second would both
match it). The loser is answered 409 in_flight and reads the winner's result
on its next GET. A test races two decisions on one run: one is served and the
action is applied once. The ten drills pass, including two replicas on one
Postgres.

subject: fix: let the model send remediation parameters at all
task:
fix: let the model send remediation parameters at all

The r3b live run (c084cbc) still escalated every proposal of an action
with a required parameter. Root cause, confirmed offline with
anthropic.transform_schema: langchain-anthropic's json_schema method
closes every object schema, so Remediation.params, an open mapping,
reached the model as {"type": "object", "properties": {},
"additionalProperties": false}. The only valid answer was params {}, so
circuit_break_dependency and rerun_partition could never pass the
runbook check. The baseline was unaffected because it calls tools.

Remediation.params stays a mapping in Python, in state, in audit records
and in scenario files. Its JSON schema is now a list of {name, value}
pairs, and a before-validator turns that list into the mapping. A
missing key, an extra key, or a repeated name is refused. No other
model-facing schema has an open mapping.

subject: fix: unescape quoted scalars in the profile YAML parser
task:
fix: unescape quoted scalars in the profile YAML parser

A double-quoted profile value such as test: "pytest -m \"not integration\""
was handed to the verifier with literal backslashes still in it, so the
command would not run. Double quotes now process escapes and single quotes
collapse a doubled quote, matching YAML.

Found while validating a real client profile, not hypothetically.

subject: fix: steadier hover on the Orion chip
task:
fix: steadier hover on the Orion chip

The whole framed plate now keeps the chip face up, so it no longer drops back
when the cursor drifts off the chip itself. Each part's hit area stops short of
its neighbours and the lifted face no longer takes the pointer, so the gaps
between parts trigger nothing. A part opens once the cursor settles on it, and
the run carries on only after the cursor has stayed off every part a moment,
so crossing a gap never flickers.
